extra.final_summary: The data had two issues affecting the question: (1) The island label 'dream' was lowercase and needed normalization to 'Dream' to match the allowed values; this was fixed with normalize_labels. (2) Three rows had negative flipper_length_mm values (-182, -210, -220), which are outside the allowed range [170, 235] and likely data entry errors; these rows were excluded. After fixes, the analysis shows 37 penguins measured on Biscoe, 19 on Dream, and 10 on Torgersen.
